test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six members (A, B, C, D, E, and F) of a family decide to have a family photo taken, and are sitting on a bed to be photographed. B is to the right of D, A is between F and C. E is standing at one of the ends and is second to the left of A. F always wants to stand next to D. Who is third from the left in the photograph?
solution:
Six members (**A, B, C, D, E, and F**) of a family decide to have a family photo taken, and are sitting on a bed to be photographed. 

1. E is standing at one of the ends and is second to the left of A.

2. B is to the right of D, A is between F and C.

3. F always wants to stand next to D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82a254634e4d3130440f6431289cf74b2a17f2151a2d3753185efad06ca20ecb.png] 

Clearly, A is third from the left in the photograph.

Hence, '**A**' is the correct answer.
